name: audit_listing_terms
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credits_sandbox.audit_listing_terms()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare x record;p jsonb;begin
 for x in select key,value from jsonb_each(new.document->'listings') loop
  p:=old.document->'listings'->x.key;
  if x.value->>'status'='OPEN' and (p is null or (p->'price',p->'revision',p->'feePolicy') is distinct from (x.value->'price',x.value->'revision',x.value->'feePolicy')) then
   insert into credits_sandbox.listing_terms_audit(listing,revision,actor,previous_terms,new_terms) values(x.key,coalesce((x.value->>'revision')::int,0),coalesce(auth.uid()::text,'fixed-price-release-migration'),p,x.value);
  end if;
 end loop;return new;end $function$

definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credits_sandbox.project_fixture_inventory()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare target record; retained jsonb; owned jsonb; e jsonb:=new.document->'economy';begin
 if e is null then return new;end if;
 for target in
  select distinct c.value->>'owner' member,p.identity->>'sport' sport
  from jsonb_each(coalesce(old.document->'commerce'->'cards','{}')||coalesce(new.document->'commerce'->'cards','{}')) c
  join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_instances i on i.id::text=c.key
  join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_players p on p.id=i.document->>'playerId'
  union
  select distinct c.value->>'owner',p.identity->>'sport'
  from jsonb_each(coalesce(old.document->'commerce'->'cards','{}')) c
  join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_instances i on i.id::text=c.key
  join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_players p on p.id=i.document->>'playerId'
 loop
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(card),'[]') into retained
  from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_inventory inv,jsonb_array_elements(inv.cards) card
  where inv.user_id=target.member::uuid and inv.sport=target.sport and card->>'inventory_source' is distinct from 'credits-fixture-v1';
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',i.id,'card_id',i.id,'player_id',coalesce(p.identity->>'fixturePlayerId',p.id),
    'owner_id',target.member,'name',p.identity->>'name','team',p.identity->>'currentTeam',
    'sport',target.sport,'position',p.identity->>'position','eligible_positions',coalesce(p.identity->'eligiblePositions',jsonb_build_array(p.identity->>'position')),
    'tier',i.document->>'rarity','serial',i.serial,'max_supply',(i.document->>'lifetimeCap')::int,
    'multiplierTenths',10,'status','active','season',case when credits_sandbox.is_roster_beta_player(p.identity) then 'REAL PLAYER · BETA INVENTORY' else 'SYNTHETIC TEST' end,'inventory_class',p.identity->>'inventoryClass','roster_source',p.identity->'rosterBeta','verifiedJerseyNumber',null,
    'inventory_source','credits-fixture-v1','listed',exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(new.document->'listings') l where l.value->>'card'=i.id::text and l.value->>'status'='OPEN')
  ) order by i.id),'[]') into owned
  from credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_instances i join credits_sandbox.nba_fixture_players p on p.id=i.document->>'playerId'
  where p.identity->>'sport'=target.sport and new.document->'commerce'->'cards'->i.id::text->>'owner'=target.member
   and e->'packs'->(i.document->>'source')->>'openedAt' is not null;
  if exists(select 1 from sports_feed.sport_sandbox_access where user_id=target.member::uuid) then
   insert into sports_feed.sport_sandbox_inventory(user_id,sport,cards) values(target.member::uuid,target.sport,coalesce(retained,'[]')||owned)
   on conflict(user_id,sport) do update set cards=excluded.cards where sport_sandbox_inventory.cards is distinct from excluded.cards;
  end if;
 end loop;
 return new;
end$function$

name: queue_sale_receipts
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION credits_sandbox.queue_sale_receipts()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare pair record;begin
 for pair in select key,value from jsonb_each(coalesce(new.document->'listings','{}')) where value->>'status'='SOLD' and value->'receipt' is not null loop
  if old.document->'listings'->pair.key->>'status' is distinct from 'SOLD' then
   insert into credits_sandbox.sale_notification_outbox(listing_id,recipient,receipt)
   values(pair.key,(pair.value->>'member')::uuid,pair.value->'receipt') on conflict do nothing;
  end if;
 end loop;return new;
end $function$

name: rarity_transfer_guard
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sports_feed.rarity_transfer_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(71820342);
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_each(old.document->'commerce'->'cards') a where a.value->>'owner' is distinct from new.document->'commerce'->'cards'->a.key->>'owner' and sports_feed.card_entry_reserved(a.key)) then
 raise exception 'Card is in an unlocked submitted team. Replace it, or withdraw before entries close';end if;
 return new;
end$function$
